<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="mFNlUqTddASSeTlByDaF"> <mxGraphModel dx="1717" dy="938" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph TD
 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 %% 1. Context & Ingestion Layer
 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 subgraph L1_Context_Layer [1. Context & Ingestion Layer]
 Trig((Raw Anomaly Trigger\ne.g., High S3 Access))
 Graph[(4-Plane Context Graph\nCode, Config, Runtime, Data)]
 Trig --> Graph
 end

 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 %% 2. Secured AI Triage Sandbox
 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 subgraph L2_AI_Sandbox [2. Secured AI Triage Sandbox]
 FW[Prompt Firewall & Sanitizer\nStops Prompt Injection]
 Inv[Investigator Agent\nForms Threat Hypothesis & Proposes Fix]
 Eval[Evaluator Agent / Skeptic\nChecks Baselines & Code History]
 Consensus{Consensus & Confidence Engine}

 Graph --> FW
 FW --> Inv
 Inv --> |Hypothesis & Fix| Eval
 Eval --> |Disproves or Confirms| Consensus
 end

 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 %% 3. Deterministic Guardrails (The Brakes)
 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 subgraph L3_Deterministic_Guardrails [3. Deterministic Guardrails]
 OPA{{OPA / Rego Policy Engine}}
 SafetyRules[(Immutable Safety Policies\ne.g., 'Never kill Prod DB')]
 
 Consensus --> |\"High Confidence Threat\"| OPA
 SafetyRules --> OPA
 end

 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 %% 4. Tiered Enforcement Router
 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 subgraph L4_Tiered_Enforcement [4. Tiered Enforcement Router]
 Router{Enforcement Tier Router}
 
 OPA --> |\"Payload Approved as Safe\"| Router
 OPA --> |\"Payload Violates Safety Rules\"| L2
 end

 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 %% 5. Execution & SOC Handoff
 %% --------------------------------------------------------
 subgraph L5_Execution [5. Execution Actions]
 
 %% False Positive Flow
 Consensus --> |\"Low Confidence / False Positive\"| FP[Level 3: Auto-Resolve\nClose SIEM Ticket & Log Rationale]
 
 %% Tier 3 Flow
 L3[Level 3: Fully Autonomous]
 Router --> |\"Low Impact / Reversible\"| L3
 L3 --> AutoFix[Execute API Payload\ne.g., Dynamic eBPF Block]

 %% Tier 2 Flow
 L2[Level 2: Human-in-the-Loop]
 Router --> |\"High Impact Fix\"| L2
 L2 --> Slack[Slack/Teams Bot\n'Approve Fix?' Button]
 Slack --> |Human Clicks Approve| AutoFix

 %% Tier 1 Flow
 L1[Level 1: AI-Assisted Manual]
 Router --> |\"Novel Attack / Critical Biz Impact\"| L1
 L1 --> Dossier[Generate Deep Forensic Dossier\nHandoff to Tier-3 Hunter]
 end

 %% Styling for visual clarity
 classDef safe fill:#e6f4ea,stroke:#1e8e3e,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef agent fill:#e8f0fe,stroke:#1967d2,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef guardrail fill:#fce8e6,stroke:#d93025,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef action fill:#fef7e0,stroke:#f29900,stroke-width:2px;

 class FP,AutoFix safe;
 class Inv,Eval,Consensus agent;
 class OPA,SafetyRules guardrail;
 class Slack,Dossier action;",
